ideal: Alert: Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6%, and no filing explains it yet. Broadcom filed its 10-Q quarterly report and an S-4 (registration of shares for a merger or exchange offer), each explained plainly and linked.

verdicts.note: Covers the Apple move with the index, says no filing explains it yet, and links both Broadcom filings with a plain explanation of what an S-4 is.
verdicts.answer:
Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6%. That's a bigger gap from the index than usual, and no filing explains it yet.
Broadcom filed its 10-Q, the quarterly report: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm
Broadcom also filed an S-4, which registers securities it plans to issue in a merger or exchange offer. The filing would show what the deal is: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526387881/d154803ds4.htm

verdicts.note: Leaves out the S-4 and doesn't say whether anything explains Apple's move; the '4.2-point' figure is a rounding of 4.16, not a number in the report.
verdicts.answer: Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6%, a 4.2-point gap. Broadcom filed a quarterly report (10-Q). [link](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm)

verdicts.note: Gets Apple's direction wrong, garbles the index wording as 'rose -0.6%', and omits both Broadcom filings.
verdicts.answer: Apple fell 3.56% while the S&P 500 rose -0.6%

verdicts.note: Complete and accurate, but 'widest gap in this report' is filler since Apple is the only price move, and it doesn't say why the S-4 matters.
verdicts.answer:
Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell 0.6% — the widest gap versus the index in this report; no filing explains it yet.
Broadcom filed its quarterly report (10-Q): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm
Broadcom also filed a registration statement (S-4): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526387881/d154803ds4.htm

verdicts.note: Covers all three events, but 'fell -0.6%' is a confusing double negative and it doesn't say whether anything explains Apple's move.
verdicts.answer:
Apple rose 3.56% while the S&P 500 fell ‑0.6%  
Broadcom filed an S‑4 (registration statement, likely merger‑related) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526387881/d154803ds4.htm  
Broadcom filed a 10‑Q (quarterly report) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000173016826000080/avgo-20260802.htm
